info.name: FynePDF API
info.description:
Compress, convert, OCR, redact, merge, split and generate PDFs, and read them with AI.

1. Get a key at https://fynepdf.com/developers/dashboard (test keys are free; results are watermarked).
2. Set the collection's `apiKey` variable.
3. Run **Files, Upload a file**: the file id is kept as `fileId` for every other request.

Docs: https://fynepdf.com/developers/docs

variable.description: Set by any request that starts a job.

item.name: Account
item.description: The key you're calling with, and the credits left on its account.

request.description: Which key and account a request runs as, and the limits that apply to it. Costs nothing.
The monthly free allowance (AI steps may use only part of it) and bought credits. Steps spend the free allowance first. Costs nothing.

item.name: Files
item.description: Every job works on files you add first: by upload URL, by public URL, or in the request body. Files and results are deleted after 24 hours.

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

formdata.description: Pick a PDF, up to 25 MB in the request.

request.description: Send the file in the request body (up to 25 MB).

item.name: Add a file from a URL

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description:
Three ways in:
- `{filename, size}`: get an `upload_url`, then `PUT` the bytes to it (large files never pass through the API).
- `{url}`: we fetch a public URL (redirects followed, private addresses refused).
- `multipart/form-data` with a `file` field: up to 25 MB, ready at once.
Files are deleted after 24 hours, or sooner with `ttl_seconds` or DELETE.
The account's current files (not deleted or expired), newest first.
The file, with a fresh one-hour `download_url` when it's ready.
Deletes the bytes now, before their expiry.
Redirects (302) to a fresh signed link. `curl -L` follows it.

item.name: Jobs
item.description: A job runs one or more steps on your files and returns a receipt: what each step did and what it cost. Wait for it in the request, poll it, or get a webhook.

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description: Input files through up to eight steps; each step feeds the next. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header so a retry never runs twice. Set `wait` to get the finished job in the same call.
The account's jobs, newest first.

item.name: Price a job without running it

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description: Checks the steps against the files and returns the credits it would cost. Nothing runs, nothing is charged.
Status, the receipt (pages and sizes before and after each step), and the outputs with fresh download links. `?wait=` up to 60 s waits for it to finish.

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description: Stops before the next step (a running step finishes first). A canceled job is refunded in full.

item.name: Actions
item.description: The catalog of steps a job can run, with their parameters and prices.

request.description: Every action, with its parameters as JSON Schema and its credit price. Costs nothing.

item.name: Shortcuts
item.description: One action as one call: POST /v1/pdf/<action> with the file and the action's parameters. The same as a one-step job.

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description:
Make a PDF smaller, at a level or under a target size. The target is checked on the final file; the receipt says whether it was met.

A one-step job (`compress`): 2 credits per 100 pages (started). Waits up to 30 s for the result by default.

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description:
Join PDFs into one, in the order given. Each file gets a bookmark with its name.

A one-step job (`merge`): 1 credit per 100 pages (started). Waits up to 30 s for the result by default.

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description:

A one-step job (`split`): 1 credit per 100 pages (started). Waits up to 30 s for the result by default.

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description:

request.description:

item.name: Web page or HTML to PDF

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description:
Render a public web page, or HTML you send, to PDF. Takes no input file, so it is the first step of a job with no inputs.

A one-step job (`html_to_pdf`): 3 credits per 50 pages (started). Waits up to 30 s for the result by default.

item.name: Create a PDF from Markdown, HTML or data

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description:
Write the content, get a well-set PDF: Markdown or HTML, a template (plain, report, invoice, letter, resume) in a quiet or classic style, page size, margins, header, footer and page numbers. Or send an invoice's, resume's or letter's fields as data and we lay it out; an invoice is added up and checked. Takes no input file.

A one-step job (`create_pdf`): 2 credits per 20 pages made (started). Waits up to 30 s for the result by default.

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description:
Remove content for real, not just cover it: rectangles you give (areas), or every occurrence of text you name (text). Text redaction is checked on the result: if any of it can still be found, the step fails and nothing is returned.

A one-step job (`redact`): 1 credit per 100 pages (started). Waits up to 30 s for the result by default.

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description:
Stamp a signature image (PNG or JPEG, uploaded as a file) on a page: at a named spot, or at x and y in points from the top-left corner. Width in points; the height follows the image.

A one-step job (`sign`): 1 credit per 100 pages (started). Waits up to 30 s for the result by default.

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description:

A one-step job (`metadata`): 1 credit per 100 pages (started). Waits up to 30 s for the result by default.

request.description:
Replace the bookmarks (outline) with your own: a title and a page each, nested by level (0 = top).

A one-step job (`bookmarks`): 1 credit per 100 pages (started). Waits up to 30 s for the result by default.

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description:
Tables to a spreadsheet. mode tables: detected from the page, no AI. mode ai: a model reads the tables (scans too). mode statement: bank statements as one checked sheet, totals compared with the statement's own. Ends the job.

A one-step job (`pdf_to_excel`): 3 credits per 50 pages (started). Waits up to 30 s for the result by default.

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description:

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description:

A one-step job (`pdf_to_latex`): 3 credits per 50 pages (started). Waits up to 30 s for the result by default.

item.name: AI
item.description: Questions, summaries, data extraction, redaction finding and edits by instruction. Answers cite their pages; extracted invoices are checked by arithmetic.

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description: An answer from the document only, with page citations. Every quote is checked against the page text; `verified: false` marks one that couldn't be found. Price: 2 credits for up to 10 pages read, +1 per further 10.

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description: A plain summary and key points, each with the pages it comes from. Priced like ask.

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description:
Structured data, checked in code where it can be:
- `invoice`: numbers, dates, parties, lines and totals; lines, subtotal, tax and total are added up and compared.
- `statement`: a bank statement's transactions; totals and balances compared with the statement's own figures.
- `tables`: every table, cell by cell, with its page.
- `schema`: your own JSON Schema (an object, up to 20 KB).
`unverified` lists values that couldn't be found in the document's text. Price: 2 credits per page read.

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description: Say what to hide ("names, emails and account numbers"); code searches the text and the model only plans the search and spots names. Returns every match by page, and a ready `redact` step that removes them (and proves it). Price: 2 credits + 1 per 2 pages.

header.description: A retry with the same key never runs or charges twice.

request.description: "Remove the blank pages, number the rest and make it PDF/A": the model plans steps from the action catalog; code checks the plan exactly like a job. `run: true` starts it as a job (its steps are priced as usual). Planning is priced like ask; a plan that can't run costs nothing.
